title: Grilled Sirloin Steak with Polish Mustard Sauce
description: A flavorful and savory dish that combines the rich flavors of sirloin steak with a tangy polish mustard sauce, served with a side of hearty kebabs.

ingredients.name: Polish Mustard
ingredients.notes: such as grey poupon or whole-grain mustard

ingredients.name: Hearty Kebabs
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Season the sirloin steak with salt and black pepper.
Grill the sirloin steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130°F - 135°F for medium-rare.
While the steak is cooking, mix the polish mustard, butter, and garlic in a small saucepan over low heat.
Simmer the mustard sauce for 2-3 minutes, or until it thickens slightly.
Remove the steak from the grill and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the steak with the polish mustard sauce spooned over the top.
Serve with hearty kebabs on the side.
